transcript.text: Yes hi, it's my husband, he has really bad chest pain.

transcript.text: How old is he and when did the pain start?

transcript.text: He's 58. It started maybe twenty minutes ago, he was just watching TV.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Where does it hurt? Does the pain go anywhere?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: In the middle, he says it's like a heavy pressure. And it goes down his left arm.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Is he short of breath or feeling sick?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: He says he feels sick, yeah. Breathing is okay I think.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: Does he have any heart problems from before?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: He has high blood pressure, he takes pills for that. Nothing else.

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: I'm sending an ambulance now with lights and sirens. Is he allergic to aspirin?

transcript.speaker: operator
transcript.text: If you have aspirin at home he can chew one tablet now. Keep him sitting, open the door, and call back right away if he faints or stops breathing.
